headline: Low clouds are holding flights into San Francisco.

items.text: The FAA has a ground delay program in effect for flights into San Francisco until 12:59 PM PT, because of low clouds. Those flights are held at their departure airports, with delays averaging 62 minutes and up to 132 minutes.
San Francisco is the only United hub with an FAA program in effect, and the other hubs are running normally.
A ground delay program is also in effect for flights into Boston (BOS) until 10:59 PM ET, because of runway construction. Delays there average 20 minutes and go up to 64 minutes.

The FAA's operations plan lists two possible programs for later, and neither is in effect: a ground stop for flights into Miami (MIA) after 1:00 PM ET, and a ground stop or ground delay program for flights into Seattle (SEA) after 2:00 PM PT.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco or Boston, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
